title: Moki & Julio: Ueda's oscillator is chaotic - a computer-assisted proof
description: Computer-assisted proof that Ueda's forced oscillator x'' + 0.05 x' + x^3 = 7.5 cos t (the case Ueda calls his 'representative' chaotic attractor) is chaotic: its time-2π map satisfies covering relations A ⇒ A, A ⇒ C0 ⇒ C1 ⇒ C2 ⇒ C3 ⇒ A on five disjoint sets around the saddle fixed point D, verified with rigorous interval arithmetic (CAPD). Hence every itinerary of one-period stays and five-period excursions is realised by a true solution, there are infinitely many periodic orbits, and the topological entropy is at least ln of the plastic number (about 0.2812 per period). The claim concerns a chaotic invariant set, not the whole observed attractor. Two independently written checkers, controls and a one-command reproduction are included. Text and figures CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
